invariants: Case details are runtime data and never graph topology.
Sensitive phases require every configured identity-verification field.
The LLM cannot directly mutate FSM state.
Explicit termination ends the call from every phase.
Two explicit refusals end the call without further persuasion.
Three consecutive unresolved repetitions of the same phase and response directive end the call directly.
Only case-approved resolution types can be selected.
Case review records a request and never implies that an unequipped system review ran.
Unambiguous acceptance of a proposed case review records the outcome once and closes without reconfirmation loops.
Internal case metadata is never exposed to the speaking model.
LiveKit remains responsible for the real-time voice pipeline.
